04 / METHODOLOGY

Built to learn.
Designed to be questioned.

A historical study of an energy-focused portfolio. Every number on this page comes from the Python project.

Data: Yahoo Finance adjusted closes
Waiting for data
01   Separate training from testing

Weights are estimated using monthly returns through December 2022, then held as fixed targets from January 2023 onwards. The optimiser never uses test-period returns. The latest unfinished month is excluded.

02   Minimise variance, not maximise returns

The objective is wᵀΣw. Weights must sum to 100%, with no short selling. The 2,000 sampled allocations illustrate alternatives; they are not an exact efficient frontier.

03   Read the measures correctly

Annual return is mean monthly return × 12. Volatility is monthly standard deviation × √12. Sharpe subtracts the 2% annual risk-free assumption before dividing by volatility. Chart growth compounds actual monthly returns.

04   Know what the model leaves out

The simulation assumes monthly rebalancing without transaction costs, management fees or taxes. Monthly drawdown misses movements within a month. Selecting companies today introduces hindsight, and historical relationships can change.
